nodes.name: A-site alloying synthesis of V₂(Sn,A)C
nodes.procedure: The powders [V, Sn (1.1 eq), C, X (0.4 eq)] were previously mixed in a stoichiometric ratio of V:Sn:C:X = 2:1.1:1:0.4, and then mixed with inorganic salts of NaCl and KCl. After grinding, the mixed powder was transferred to an alumina boat, subsequently placed into a tube furnace. The mixed starting powder was heated to 1,100°C with a heating rate of 10°C min⁻¹ under Ar atmosphere, and maintained at this temperature for 3 h. After cooling, the products were washed with deionized water, H₂SO₄ and HF to remove impurities, and dried at 40°C in vacuum.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD pattern of VSNC shows typical 211 MAX phase diffraction peaks at 2θ=13°, 26°, and 40° similar to V₂AlC.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diffraction pattern of VSNC is similar to that of V₂AlC 211 phase, with the typical diffraction peaks at 2θ-13°, 2θ-26°, and 2θ-40° (Figure 2a).

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS shows relative atomic ratio of V:(Sn+Ni) ≈ 2:1 matching 211 MAX phase stoichiometry.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The energy-dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) result shows the relative atomic ratio of V:(Sn+Ni) is ≈2:1, which matches with the stoichiometry of 211 MAX phase (Figure S2).

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM along [1120] shows one brighter A atomic layer (Sn/Ni) interleaved by two darker M atomic layers (V) identified by Z contrast.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 2c, one brighter A atomic layer (Sn/Ni) is interleaved by two darker M atomic layers (V), which is identified by the difference of Z contrast.
The selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern presents a single-phase (Figure 2b).

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows generated reconstructed surface on VSNC after electrochemical cycling.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Such surface reconstruction is also evidenced by high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image, where the generated reconstructed surface can be clearly observed on the surface of the VSNC. (Figure 2e).

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman spectra show peaks at ≈481 and ≈554 cm⁻¹ at 1.45 V vs RHE attributed to E_g (bending) and A_{1g} (stretching) modes of γ-NiOOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: When the potential increases to 1.45 V versus RHE, a pair of Raman vibration peaks at ≈481 and ≈554 cm⁻¹ is observed, which can be attributed to the depolarized E_g mode (bending, δ) and the polarized A_{1g} mode (stretching, ν) of γ-NiOOH, respectively. (Figure 2f).

nodes.characterization_summary: EELS spectrum of R-VSNC shows presence of Ni, V, and O elements in reconstructed counterpart.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HAADF-STEM image together with the electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) spectrum of reconstructed VSNC (R-VSNC) shows the presence of Ni, V, and O elements in the reconstructed counterpart (Figure 2i,j).

nodes.characterization_summary: V K-edge XANES shows pre-edge at ≈5470 eV and main peak at ≈5485 eV indicating high local symmetry of V atoms.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The V K-edge X-ray absorption near-edge structure spectroscopy (XANES) of VSNC presents a pre-edge (marked as A) at ≈5470 eV and a main absorption peak (marked as B) at ≈5485 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: FT-EXAFS shows V-C shell at ≈1.5 Å and V-V shell at ≈2.3 Å with higher V-V intensity indicating lower V vacancy content.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Fourier transform X-ray absorption fine structure (FT-EXAFS) spectrum of VSNC... with a V-C shell and V-V shell at ≈1.5 and 2.3 Å, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge XANES displays similar feature to Ni foil indicating metallic state.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ni K-edge XANES spectrum of VSNC displays a similar feature to that of Ni foil, indicating an overall metallic state in VSNC.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge EXAFS shows Ni-Sn and Ni-Ni shells at 2.63 Å with CN=3.7 and 1.4 respectively.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ni K-edge EXAFS spectrum of VSNC shows a main peak, which could be fitted by a Ni-Sn shell and a Ni-Ni shell both with the similar bond distance of 2.63 Å.

nodes.characterization_summary: Sn 3d XPS of R-VSNC shows enhanced oxidative state of Sn⁴⁺ compared to initial VSNC.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Compared to initial VSNC, the Sn 3d XPS spectrum of R-VSNC exhibits the much-enhanced oxidative state of Sn⁴⁺ (Figure 3e).

nodes.characterization_summary: V L-edge soft XAS of R-VSNC shows features corresponding to V₂O₃ with fine structures from crystal field effect.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The VSNC displays a typical feature of V₂C, while the R-VSNC presents a completely different line type corresponding to V₂O₃ compound.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-AES measures content of V/Sn/Ni/Co/Fe cations in pristine samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The content of V/Sn/Ni/Co/Fe cations in pristine samples was measured by inductively coupled plasma atomic emission spectroscopy (ICP-AES, Agilent 5110).
